title: CLCON/365/2015 of Sanjay Kumar Sharma Vs R.k. Uniyal AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
CLCON No.365 of 2015
Hon'ble U. C. Dhyani, J.
Mr. Sushil Vashistha, Advocate present for
the petitioner.
By way of present Contempt Petition, the
petitioner seeks to punish the respondents-contemnors for willful disobedience of Order dated
25.10.2013 passed by coordinate bench of this
Court in Writ Petition No.1300 of 2008 (S/S).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and
perused the order dated 25.10.2013, which is sought
to be enforced by the petitioner.
The relevant portion of the aforesaid order
reads as follows:
"8. Consequently, the writ petition is allowed.
Writ of mandamus is issued directing the
respondents to grant seniority and consequential
benefits to the petitioner from the date when
juniors to him in the merit list were provided
appointment on the post of Assistant Teacher.
However, the petitioner will not be entitled for
salary for the period he has not worked."
 Learned counsel for the petitioner submits
that the respondents have not complied with the
aforesaid order passed by coordinate bench of this
Court.
Since no time limit was fixed by the
coordinate bench of this Court in the order dated
25.10.2013, hence, this Court reiterates the order
dated 25.10.2013 passed by the coordinate bench,
instead of issuing notices on contempt petition to
the respondents.
 Contempt petition is disposed of with the
directions to the respondents to ensure compliance
of the order dated 25.10.2013 within a period of
eight weeks from the date of production of a
certified copy of this order. In order to remind the
respondents, the petitioner shall move a fresh
representation alongwith a copy of this order, as
also the order dated 25.10.2013. The respondents

are directed to grant seniority and consequential
benefits to the petitioner from the date when juniors
to him in the merit list were provided appointment
on the post of Assistant Teacher. However, the
petitioner will not be entitled for salary for the
period he has not worked.
This Court has not issued notices on
contempt petition to the respondents, inasmuch as,
one of the objects of the contempt jurisdiction is to
ensure compliance of the order passed by this
Court. Instead, the Court has reiterated the earlier
order with the hope that respondent authority (ies)
shall comply / execute the same.
Let a certified copy of this order be supplied
to learned counsel for the petitioner today itself, on
payment of usual charges.
